sections.label: Filename
sections.description: Measurement file to import; browse on disk or choose a registered dataset.

sections.label: Format
sections.description: Detect vendor/text format automatically, or explicitly choose CSV, YAML or fixed-width text.

sections.label: Fixed-width columns
sections.description: Fixed-width field widths (5, 7), or zero-based start/stop ranges ((3, 8), (10, 17)).

sections.label: Delimiter
sections.description: CSV delimiter; leave empty to infer commas, tabs, semicolons or whitespace.

sections.label: Header
sections.description: Read column names from the header line; for fixed-width text it follows the skipped preamble.

sections.label: Skip rows
sections.description: Number of preamble rows skipped before the table header or numeric data.

sections.label: X values
sections.description: Use the selected X column. Disable to generate consecutive channel numbers.

sections.label: X column
sections.description: Zero-based column containing time-channel numbers.

sections.label: Y column
sections.description: Zero-based column containing fluorescence counts.

sections.label: X error
sections.description: Read standard deviations of channel numbers from the selected X-error column.

sections.label: X error column
sections.description: Zero-based column of X standard deviations; converted to the calibrated time-axis units.

sections.label: Y error
sections.description: Use supplied count standard deviations. Otherwise use the established photon-counting noise.

sections.label: Y error column
sections.description: Zero-based column of count standard deviations; independent errors combine in quadrature when rebinned.

sections.label: dt [ns/ch]
sections.description: Time resolution per channel in nanoseconds.

sections.label: scale dt
sections.description: If enabled, the time-axis dt is multiplied by the y-rebin factor (set automatically for stacked VV/VH files).

sections.label: rebin x
sections.description: Rebin factor along the x-axis: neighbouring channels are summed, e.g. a value of 2 turns '1,2,3,4' into '3,7'.

sections.label: rebin y
sections.description: Rebin factor along the y-axis: neighbouring counts are summed, e.g. a value of 2 turns '1,2,3,4' into '3,7'.

sections.label: rep. [MHz]
sections.description: The repetition rate of the laser in MHz.

sections.label: stacked
sections.description: Treat the file as stacked VV/VH: the parallel and perpendicular detection channels are stored vertically one after another. Disables the header row and scales dt by the rebin factor.

sections.label: pol.
sections.description: Polarization channel(s) to read: magic-angle, parallel, perpendicular, or stacked VV,VH.

sections.label: g-factor
sections.description: Detection-efficiency ratio (g-factor) between the parallel and perpendicular channels.

sections.label: l1
sections.description: Polarization leakage correction for the parallel channel.

sections.label: l2
sections.description: Polarization leakage correction for the perpendicular channel.

sections.label: Link l1/l2
sections.description: Keep the perpendicular leakage equal to the parallel leakage while editing l1.

sections.label: VH shift [ch]
sections.description: Channel shift of the perpendicular decay relative to the parallel decay.

buttons.label: g-factor
buttons.description: Open the VV/VH calibration inspector; completed G, shift and mixing estimates are applied when its window closes.
